rationale: The only implementation delta is that the fixed version rejects an empty input buffer before dereferencing the first byte (`REMAIN == 0 || REMAIN > INT_MAX`), whereas the vulnerable version rejects only oversized buffers. The Logic section does not state that empty tokens are rejected, that buffer length is checked before access, or any equivalent fixed-only guard. Its statements about verifying token headers, handling malformed tokens, updating negotiation state and buffers, preparing a continuation token on success, and cleanup are either true of both implementations or sufficiently abstract not to address the empty-buffer delta.
